name: spoiler-text
title: Spoiler Text
description: Text hidden under a shimmering field of specks. Click or press Enter to blow them away and read it. Screen readers hear a spoiler button until it opens.

props.name: revealed
props.description: Controlled state. Leave it out and the spoiler keeps its own.

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: Called when the text is revealed.

props.name: label
props.description: What screen readers hear while the text is hidden.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the text plainly and ignores clicks.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
